authorization: Nico explicitly requests 3EMA crossover/sweep/time filters and several assets, without L2; does not open protected outcomes
ema: Three separate EMAs, not TEMA; adjustFalse continuous observed Globex closes, reset contract;600barburn-in; no synthetic gap bars

events.CROSS: EMA20 crosses EMA50 at completed close; close aboveEMA200 long/below short
events.SWEEP: PriorEMA20>50>200/priorclose>50 for long; low at least1tick below FROZEN priorEMA50 and currentclose back above. Symmetric short. OHLCgeometry, not certified stoprun/liquidity event

filters.DWELL30: Six strictly prior consecutive5min closes on direction side of theirEMA50
filters.SLOPE200: PriorEMA200 has moved in entry direction over6bar/30min
filters.ADX25: Strictly prior ADX14 Wilder >=25; trend strength only

filter_comparison: All filtered versions subset same reserved BASEevent slots; no rescheduling; delta vsBASE descriptive, not causal or confirmatory incremental test
warmup: Percontract up to7calendar days before earliest chosen session; past price history only; min600real observed5minbars
holding: Onehour after actualentry. Shared BASEslot spacing>1h+60s; replay verifies no actual overlaps
entry: First valid exported bid/ask quote after signal+250ms, within30s. If unavailable, NO_ENTRY, not an excluded filled trade or realized loss
exit: First valid quote at or after entry+1h; no1s exitlag censor. Max known trading deadline16ET; any filled trade without exit quote blocks cell inference. Quote age/fills still not certified
normalization: U=known prior WilderATR14 ticks of5minbars. net/alpha reported inU, not riskR. Tick means retained per instrument, not comparable price magnitude
primary: Mean netU and directedmidchangeU vsrandomdirectionatidenticalentry/exittimes; 24cellsx2=48Bonferroni one-sided bounds
boundaries: No outcomes outside Oct–Dec2025. No automatic Jan–Mar validation. Julyholdout and otherreserves closed
known_exposure: Development already exposed in otherresearch, especially RTY; 3equityindexassetscorrelated, not independentreplications
catalog: Existing prior-session contract selection and quality-session scope inherited. Raw warmup prices may include non-target sessions; no target-label analysis there
pending_filters: Session/news filters need dated calendar. No hindsight exclusion
stop: No parameter grid, no invertlosing signal or extendwindow torescue; freeze newhypothesis separately
